measurement.scope: FP32 vector FMA and logical streaming memory peaks only; unmeasured vector/tensor precisions remain null.
notes: Memory buffers are 256 MiB and 1024 MiB each, exceeding the 64 MiB L2. Logical bandwidth is not a measurement of DRAM-controller transactions.

concatenate.scope: The 42 fp32/fp16/bfloat16 native NVIDIA concatenate cases; other dtypes have no valid reference.
concatenate.rationale: Explicit Thead logical read/write bandwidth proxy for data movement. Same logical storage widths; traffic_ratio=1.
concatenate.limitations: Approximate scaling only. Small repeated buffers, strided accesses, cache residency and launch latency may dominate; not a measured bottleneck conclusion.

gen_index.scope: The 28 fp32/int32 native NVIDIA gen_index cases.

gen_index.limitations: Approximate scaling only. Tiny outputs may be launch/cache limited; integer arithmetic is not characterized by this bandwidth peak.

gelu_approx_tanh_backward.limitations: FMA throughput does not measure tanh throughput. Cache and launch effects may dominate, especially small cases. Not a measured bottleneck conclusion.

hygon-20261010.selection: Highest throughput computed from the median of all 100 samples for each configuration; same sweep and FMA/logical-byte counts as NVIDIA.

ascend-20261013.validation: All 600 hbm_copy samples passed exact checks on 32 distributed 1024-element output windows and both inputs. Validation occurred before timing, after every round, and after full-output poisoning plus graph replay. No vector/FMA metric was measured.
ascend-20261013.scope: Measured hbm_copy only. All other Ascend peaks remain unmeasured.
ascend-20261013.collector_note: The archive preserves the exact measured source, SHA-256 collector_sha256. Subsequent changes to the repository collector only improve source snapshots and operation-specific metadata; no measured kernel or timing code was changed after collection.
ascend-20261013.statistic_definition: For each configuration take the arithmetic median of all 100 per-launch elapsed_ms values (average the two middle values), compute work_per_launch / (median_ms * 1e9), then choose the maximum configuration rate. This matches the NVIDIA and Hygon vector/memory collectors; it is not the arithmetic median of per-sample rates.
ascend-20261013.statistic_metadata_correction: Clarified the statistic label on 2026-10-13 after rechecking all 600 archived samples. Measurement code, raw data, configuration results and hbm_copy peak are unchanged. The archive retains the original measurement-time source and its original label.

nvidia-missing-20261012.source_state: Working-tree collector extensions; source snapshots and SHA256 list are archived.

gpu_activity.observation: GPU utilization was 0% before and after. A resident 536 MiB allocation (PID 3275245, outside the visible process namespace) remained; six preflight pmon samples showed no compute activity. This is not proof of exclusive device ownership.
gpu_activity.collection: All benchmark subprocesses ran sequentially; one-second power, clock, utilization and memory monitoring is archived.

timing.method: CUDA events around one CUDA Graph batch; per-call us = batch us / executions
timing.excluded: build, allocation, uploads/downloads, layout conversion, host oracle and validation

validation.identity_main: 12 BF16 main cases use numeric exact comparison at atol=rtol=0; this is not bit_exact.
validation.identity_aux: 36 BF16/INT32/BOOL auxiliary cases use exact original storage bytes/bits.

nvidia-missing-20261012.scope: Appendix 1 only. No peak remeasurement, no modifications to any platform peaks/policies, no Hygon implementation or regression claim. The 491 existing unavailable cases and the 70+12 out-of-scope cases were not retried.

nvidia-supplement-20261015.reference_peaks: Unchanged H100 80GB HBM3 / 700 W peaks in platforms.nvidia; matching model, architecture, power limit and cuDNN version. GPU UUID recorded separately.
nvidia-supplement-20261015.archive_retention: Not distributed in source control; original digest retained for provenance.
nvidia-supplement-20261015.cross_platform_scope: No changes to other backends, shared kernels, reference CPU implementations, policies, peaks, or threshold. Target platform integration remains separate.
nvidia-supplement-20261015.artifact_audit: Frozen source members and archived collector verified by SHA256; linked archive fingerprints retained as build provenance.
